gaps.explanation: Every governmental fund is in detail[] (General Fund, Veterans Aid subfund, Federal Grants and all 17 nonmajor funds), but from the Budget and Actual - Budgetary Basis schedules (pp9-11, 15-32), while the statement (p5) is GAAP. Printed totals add exactly to the schedule total 188,382,825. GAAP (p5, pp12-14) minus budgetary per fund: General 143,526,993 - 142,217,664 = 1,309,329 (p10 'Revenue accruals' 1,309,328); Federal Grants 34,884,326 - 7,503,649 (p11) = 27,380,677; Visitors Improvement 2,316,121 - 2,353,261 = -37,140; County Visitors Promotion 2,316,121 - 2,353,261 = -37,140; Rural Library 1,007,044 - 977,112 = 29,932; Keno 1,689,403 - 1,553,432 = 135,971; Gaming Tax 1,356,256 - 1,340,403 = 15,853; Economic Development 183 - 184 = -1; Mental Health 4,118,740 - 3,915,575 = 203,165; Weed Control 315,027 - 315,028 = -1; Building 634,175 - 1,021,576 = -387,401; County Property Management 4,701,690 - 4,697,136 = 4,554; City Building Maintenance 309,570 - 309,568 = 2; Assemble Lincoln 75,001 - 75,002 = -1; Correctional Facility JPA 4,242,453 - 4,132,611 = 109,842; Law Enforcement Equipment 271,753 - 271,753 = 0; Bridge and Special Road 1,573,842 - 1,523,019 = 50,823; Highway 13,384,041 - 13,368,977 = 15,064; Sinking 453,683 - 453,614 = 69. Sum = 28,793,597 = gap (statement 217,176,422). No fix.

Budgetary-basis schedule totals add exactly to 210,729,286: General 127,204,776 (p10) + Veterans Aid 12,198 (p32) = 127,216,974 vs GAAP Total General 127,173,945 (p12; Veterans Aid GAAP 14,832): +43,029 (p10 expenditure accruals (1,481,760), encumbrances 1,527,424); Federal Grants 33,291,601 (p11) vs GAAP 30,288,106 (p5): +3,003,495; 17 nonmajor budget schedules (pp15-31) 50,220,711 vs GAAP nonmajor column 48,615,023 (p5/p14): +1,605,688 (largest: Highway 19,759,434 vs 16,384,403; Bridge and Special Road 8,435,816 vs 9,424,338; Mental Health 4,368,816 vs 4,687,027; Sinking 3,374,692 vs 3,638,740). 43,029 + 3,003,495 + 1,605,688 = 4,652,212 = schedule above statement (206,077,074, p5). No fix.

Statement transfers in 18,468,531 (p5). Detail adds the Veterans Aid subfund's transfer in 20,000 (p32) to the General Fund 1,035,462 and nonmajor funds; the General Fund combining schedule (p12) eliminates it (Veterans Aid 20,000, Elimination (20,000)), so the statement omits it. 18,488,531 - 18,468,531 = 20,000 = elimination only. No fix.

Statement transfers out 18,868,531 (p5; General (14,458,524)). Detail uses the General Fund budget schedule's Transfers out (14,478,524) (p10), which is before the 20,000 elimination of the transfer to the Veterans Aid subfund (p12: General Fund (14,478,524), Elimination 20,000, Total General (14,458,524)). 18,888,531 - 18,868,531 = 20,000. No fix.
